title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
2001 M Street, NW Suite 600
Washington, DC 20036
+1 202 682 7000 tel
+1 202 857 0940 fax



June 30, 2025
Zachary D. Tripp
+1 (202) 682-7220
Zack.Tripp@weil.com

Via Filing and Messenger
Hon. Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543
Re: Landor v. Louisiana Department of Corrections & Public Safety, et al., No.
23-1197
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  I write to request an
extension of time to file the briefs as follows:
Brief of petitioner and joint appendix:  August 27, 2025
Brief of respondents:    October 1, 2025
Reply brief of petitioner:    October 24, 2025
The parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, which would enable this case to
be heard during the Court’s November sitting.  Should you need any additional
information from me, please do not hesitate to let me know.

Yours sincerely,
Zachary D. Tripp
